tour.title: Jibot Adapter Runtime
tour.description: Inspect the adapter entry point and main Adapter class to see how MQTT, VDA5050 orders, hardware IO, and robot state publishing are coordinated.

tour.description: Review the VDA5050 model files that define orders, actions, state, connection, and shared protocol enums used by the adapter.

tour.title: Drive and ACS Control
